name: Water fittings, per each
label: crew sheet, no published rate
why: No published point for fittings. Nearest proxy: WSDOT installing valves 3 EA per 8 h (3.75 per 10 h, row 398) is heavier work than a fitting, so the sheet 1 EA/day looks conservative; not used because it is not the same work.

name: Bore pit
label: crew sheet, no published rate
why: No published bore-pit point in the research file.

name: Pressure testing
label: crew sheet, no published rate
why: Only per-LF test rates are published (WSDOT testing sewer pipe 1,000 LF per 8 h, row 396). The sheet counts tests (EA) and the test section length is not stated, so no conversion.

name: Castings adjusted
sources_states: ADOT Production Rates Guidelines for Ari AZ; FDOT Utility Relocation Schedule Manual FL; NCDOT Contract Time Guidelines NC; WSDOT Plans Preparation Manual M 22-31.1 WA (8 h x1.25)
label: published production
why: Sheet 1 differs from published 5 by 80% with no stated reason; published figure used. Castings = manhole frames, catch-basin grates, valve boxes. FDOT rows are days per EA (EA/day = 1/x). NCDOT rows 215 and 570 are the same 8-10/day figure in two documents (counted once). ADOT hours not stated (only implied ~8 h), not scaled.

name: Sewer service, per each
sources_states: WSDOT Plans Preparation Manual M 22-31.1 WA (8 h x1.25)
label: published production
why: Sheet 1 differs from published 4.38 by 77% with no stated reason; published figure used. Only published point is WSDOT Service Connection 3.5 per 8 h (a water service connection); the same figure the tier file uses for Water service. Used as the proxy for a sewer service; no sewer-specific point exists. A sewer service is usually deeper than a water service, so this is a ceiling, not a floor.

name: Rock in trench, by truck
label: crew sheet, no published rate
why: Unit EA (sheet 2/day) has no published equivalent; rock rates are published in CY (rock excavation 730-1,000 CY/day). Unit not convertible.

name: Rock in trench, by dozer
label: crew sheet, no published rate
why: Unit EA (sheet 2/day) has no published equivalent; rock rates are published in CY. Unit not convertible.

name: Roof drains
sources_states: WSDOT Plans Preparation Manual M 22-31.1 WA (8 h x1.25); WisDOT Production Rate Table WI; INDOT Memo 97-27 Guidelines for Setting  IN; MDT / Iowa State Univ. InTrans: Effectiv MT
label: published production
why: Sheet 200 is within 11% of published 225; sheet figure kept as supported. Roof drain lines are small shallow pipe; matched to small-pipe points: WSDOT drain pipe (8 h), WisDOT pipe underdrains, INDOT underdrains, MDT drainage pipe <=24 in. Proxy, not roof-drain specific.

name: Stone base, on site
sources_states: MoDOT EPG 237.8 Contract Time Determinat MO
label: published production
why: Sheet 2500 is within 27% of published 3439; sheet figure kept as supported. Only SY point: MoDOT Aggregate Base 4 in (AGC average column, hours not stated, not scaled). TON and CY points need a density or a thickness the points do not state, so they are not converted. Highway mainline rate; an on-site lot is slower. Difference measured against published is 27% (37% if measured against the sheet): borderline.

name: Sidewalk rework
label: crew sheet, no published rate
why: No published sidewalk remove-and-replace point. Proxies only: KY concrete repair 30 SY/day (270 SF), INDOT removal of sidewalk 1,500 SF/day; neither is the same work.

name: Concrete pavement, light duty (5-6 in)
sources_states: TxDOT 2024 Construction Production Rates TX; CTR Research Report 0-4416-1 Development TX
label: published production
why: Sheet 80 differs from published 57.3 by 40% with no stated reason; published figure used. Formed/hand-pour concrete paving points only (slipform highway rates excluded): TxDOT hand pour, CTR conventional formed (Table 3.9 and the 360-2 regression range), O'Connor et al. (same data as CTR, counted once). Median 343.5 SY/day, the same basis the tier file uses for formed pavement (350 SY). Converted at 6 in: CY = SY x 6/36 = SY/6.

name: Tree removal, 6-12 in
label: replaced by A5 (published production)

Urban bucket-truck work, slow for open-site trees.
